observations: Black mesh office chair with a contoured backrest and a black fabric seat.
Chrome five-star base with black casters.
Adjustable height column with a silver lever.
Integrated lumbar support and a headrest on the backrest.
The chair is positioned on a yellow rug in a living room setting.
A watermark 'SUNSHINE FURNITURE' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: The chair appears structurally sound in the photo, but there is no visual proof of its previous condition.

claims.claim: Bought new last year, no stain, no tear, foam still firm. From a smoke free home.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The height adjustment mechanism may be jammed or the gas cylinder may be leaking.
risks.proof: A video showing the height lever being operated and the chair rising and falling smoothly.

risks.risk: The mesh backrest may have hidden tears or wear not visible in the current angle.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the mesh material on the back and sides.

risks.risk: The gas cylinder may be expired or the valve may be faulty.
risks.proof: A photo of the manufacturer's label showing the date of manufacture.

proof_requests: Video of the height adjustment working.
Close-up photos of the mesh backrest and the underside of the seat.
Photo of the manufacturer's label on the base or frame.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
